{{Quote|More than five millennia ago the Denarii Nova exploded, ripping through these stars and reducing them to cinders.|[[Brakiss]], to [[Zekk]]|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
The '''Denarii Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] of highly ionized [[Gas/Legends|gases]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained a [[Binary star/Legends|pair]] of dying [[Star/Legends|stars]] known as the [[Denarii Nova]].<ref name="Lightsabers" /><ref name="TERC" />

The Denarii Nebula was the remnant of the [[Denarii system]], a double-star [[Star system/Legends|system]] that was [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|destroyed]] by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] at the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] circumnavigated the nebula. [[Scout/Legends|Scouts]] had struggled to find a stable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] between the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Pinoora]] and [[Presbalin]], on opposite sides of the Denarii Nebula. [[Denarii Station]] was located within the nebula.<ref name="TEA" />
